Package com.simpfi.config

Class SimulationConfig

java.lang.Object
com.simpfi.config.SimulationConfig
public class SimulationConfig extends Object
Holds configuration parameters that control how the simulation is displayed and executed. This includes scaling factors, coordinate offsets, simulation timestep, and playback speed.
